title: Can I make area specific events without copying and pasting the same events over and over again?

posts.author: elang_S
posts.body:
I want to add some flavor text/events that is triggerable when the player moves their character in multiple areas (for example sand areas trigger sand specific dialogues, water areas trigger water specific dialogues, etc), but I fear that manually copying and pasting the same events over and over just to make a large enough area for the player to enter will needlessly raise the storage needed for the game
Is there a more effective way to make a large enough interactable environment without resorting to copying and pasting?
